name: Translate Telegram audio messages with AI (55 supported languages)
description: Receives voice messages, transcribes them, and sends back translations in over 50 languages.

source.n8nName: Translate Telegram audio messages with AI (55 supported languages) v1

setup: "Telegram Trigger" (telegramTrigger) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.

Workflow secret TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN: Telegram bot token (from @BotFather) for api.telegram.org (URL path /bot<secret>/getFile). Add it in the workflow editor's Secrets panel after import; never paste it in chat.

hints: The original started from telegramTrigger; Yantra has no webhook slug for it, so run on demand, on a schedule (add a NodeCron), or via the workflow API with the event under the run input `event`.
"Telegram1" (telegram.file.get): Uses the Telegram Bot API getFile HTTP call with the bot token from a workflow secret; download file_path from the JSON result.
"Telegram1": the file itself is at https://api.telegram.org/file/bot<token>/<file_path>; the token is the TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN workflow secret.
"Telegram1": a request field used $('OtherNode'); on Yantra $() resolves via the named upstream map when that node ran earlier, else the immediate upstream - check that expression.
"OpenAI2" transcribes the Telegram voice file by URL (Bot API file path) with the platform Whisper; no OpenAI key needed.
"OpenAI" used OpenAI text to speech; the platform voice speaks the text and returns audioUrl (a stored audio file) instead of binary audio.
"Audio reply" sent the generated file by URL instead of as binary.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect telegram: `cdecli credential create -n "telegram" -p telegram --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).

notes:
## Translation

- Converts from speech to text.

- Translates the language from the native language to translated language (as specified in settings node)

## Telegram output

- Provide the output in both text as well as speech. 

- Many languages are supported including English,French, German, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese.

Full list here:
https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/speech-to-text/supported-languages

## Multi-lingual AI Powered Universal Translator with Speech ⭐

### Key capabilities
This flow enables a Telegram bot that can 
- accept speech in one of 55 languages 
- translates to another language and returns result in speech

### Use case:
- Learning a new language
- Communicate with others while traveling to another country

### Setup
- Open the Settings node and specify the languages you would like to work with
